relations.note: Basandere is repeatedly described as Basajaun's wife and supernatural accomplice.

relations.myth: Leap across the Basajauns' wheat heap
relations.note: San Martín challenges the Basajauns to leap across their grain heap.

relations.myth: The theft of wheat at Muskia
relations.note: San Martín steals the Basajauns' wheat by filling his broad sandals.
San Martín secretly overhears a Basajaun's song explaining when crops should be sown.
San Martín's false claim induces Basajaun to reveal the chestnut-leaf model.
Trying to spoil the saw, Basajaun accidentally improves it by alternating its teeth.
San Martín tricks or overhears Basajaun into revealing a welding or foundry technique.
San Martín falsely claims success, prompting Basajaun to reveal the missing mill component.

relations.myth: The theft of marvellous golden objects
relations.note: The trickster Haxerihargaitz steals wondrous golden possessions from Basajauns.
Hartsuaga proposes Saint Anthony as a Christianized successor to the livestock-protecting Basajaun.
